verdict.rationale: Docusaurus builds static HTML files via `npm run build` into a `build` directory, which can be hosted on any static host (Vercel, GitHub Pages, Netlify, Render, Surge) or served locally via `docusaurus serve`, confirming no vendor lock-in. Community comments corroborate real-world deployment and migration flexibility. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of exporting/re-hosting a site across multiple providers beyond docs claims.
